integrity: The analytical coefficient calculation is the proof; independent numerical quadrature is supplementary and does not certify infinite-dimensional or arbitrary-dimensional extensions.
scientific_limitations: Exact planar SPD linear-residual quadratic and two sequential exact line minimizers only; no assertion for safeguarded nonlinear Gauss–Newton, dimension above two, or computational-runtime advantage; prior-work equivalence not exhaustively ruled out.
title: Exact orthogonal-pair advantage for planar random-subspace Gauss–Newton
